title: Qake - Multiplayer 2.5D Shooter
author: proc_
selftext:
Partially used and combined old hand-written game engine code from old projects of mine.Then used these with Claude to create a multiplayer action shooter. Can be played with both bots or towards other players. Higher levels yields no extra perk more than cool clothes/hats/pets.

Account is created just to claim the name to get unique stats etc. Can be played locally in the browser towards bots w/o account (then no level/exp is counted).

  
As I've made quite a lot of these voxel-like engines in the past it was rather easy to know where to optimize and get claude to help out. Some sounds are from [opengameart.org](http://opengameart.org) and credited in the license parts of the credits page. Most sounds are basic generated sounds.

  
It works on mobile as well, but the game experience is not as good as on PC as it's built for using mouse to aim.

  
It can be played on [https://qake.se](https://qake.se)

Feedback is welcome and it is under development so I will add/change things as I go!
